meaning:
κατα-φεύγω
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;]
to flee for refuge: before εἰς, Act.14:6; metaphorically, with inf., Heb.6:18.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope…
